title: Motion for an extension of time to file the joint appendix and petitioner's brief on the merits

pages.text:
LISA S. BLATT
(202) 434-5050
lblatt@wc.com



May 7, 2025
VIA ELECTRONIC FILING
Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543

Re: Holsey Ellingburg, Jr. v. United States, No. 24-482
Dear Mr. Harris:
I represent petitioner in the above- captioned matter.  I write to request a  30-day
extension of time , through and including June 23, 2025,  to file petitioner’s opening brief.
Absent an extension, petitioner’s opening brief will be due May 22, 2025.  Petitioner
requested the government’s position regarding a briefing schedule on April 8, April 18, and
April 28, 2025.  While the government has been responsive and has indicated that it will
support mutual extensions of time, it has not yet been able to provide its view on a concrete
briefing schedule.
The requested 30 -day extension would enable this case to be heard during the
Court’s October 2025 sitting  and would enable the government to receive a reciprocal 30 -
day extension of time  to file its response brief .  Petitioner submits that the requested
extension is appropriate given counsel’s other commitments.
Should you need any additional information from me, please do not hesitate to let
me know.
       Sincerely,
       /s/ Lisa S. Blatt
       Lisa S. Blatt
cc: D. John Sauer, Counsel for Respondent
